answer: Presence is measured, not claimed. A key gains quorum weight only after attesting in consecutive epochs, and one missed window resets the streak, so standing accrues at the speed of the calendar and cannot be bought inside a single block. A farm therefore pays in labour as well as fees: every identity needs its own passing text each round, so a thousand clones demand a thousand graded answers, and none can idle offline for long without losing rank. Stockpiled replies fail too, since a paragraph about a plume of umber smoke over a wharf satisfies only the round that asked for it.
